description: Resolve or dismiss a finding. Set a finding's status — `resolved` (it was fixed; say how in `reason`), `dismissed` (it is not a problem; say why), or back to `open`. A finding that is real but out of scope is not dismissed: promote it with `trails promote-finding`.

agent.description: Your agent type, when an agent is resolving the finding.

findingId.description: A resource path identifier — an opaque `xxx_<ULID>` id (~30 chars) or the resource's `name`/`key`. 1–128 characters; the upper bound matches the longest name/key any resource accepts, so an over-long value can never name a real row.

handle.description: The trail's handle (`T-12`) or its id.

reason.description: Why — the fixing commit, or why it is not a problem.

status.description: A finding stays `open` until it is `resolved` (fixed) or `dismissed` (not a problem). A finding raised on an earlier push is reported `stale` but stays open until somebody decides.

name: trails_update_finding
